summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; client_id from login or extra.client_id, client_secret from password or extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var references for both secrets, with profile args applied before those fixed keys). Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and inserted it into profile_mappings directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, auth/secret override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run and no code was executed, per instructions; everything was verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
